title: 5G home internet weak signal
body:
FWA performance depends heavily on CPE placement; use the app's signal bars to find the best spot.

Procedure:
1. Check 5G coverage and cell loading for the installation address.
2. Ask the customer to reposition the 5G CPE near a window facing the tower and note the SINR/RSRP in the app.
3. Lock the CPE to the n78 band from the management portal and test again.
4. Upgrade CPE firmware and reboot.
5. Offer an outdoor antenna install visit if signal quality stays below -105 dBm.

Escalation: if the problem persists after the steps above, raise a Tier-2 ticket referencing fwa_no_5g_signal and attach the diagnostics collected.

title: 5G home internet intermittent drops
body:
Evening drops on FWA are mostly sector congestion; verify before replacing hardware.

Procedure:
1. Check sector congestion on the serving 5G cell during the reported hours.
2. Review CPE logs for handovers and detach events.
3. Switch the CPE to a less loaded band or carrier if available.
4. Log a capacity ticket if sector utilisation is consistently above 85%.
5. Follow up in 72 hours to confirm stability.

Escalation: if the problem persists after the steps above, raise a Tier-2 ticket referencing fwa_dropouts and attach the diagnostics collected.

title: 5G home router activation problems
body:
Activation stalls normally mean the CPE SIM is not linked to the order or KYC is pending.

Procedure:
1. Verify the CPE serial number and embedded SIM are linked to the customer's order.
2. Trigger provisioning of the CPE SIM from the activation system.
3. Ask the customer to power-cycle the CPE and run the setup wizard again.
4. Complete pending KYC verification if the activation is held.
5. Replace the CPE if the SIM remains unprovisioned after 24 hours.

Escalation: if the problem persists after the steps above, raise a Tier-2 ticket referencing fwa_activation and attach the diagnostics collected.
